codeExamples.code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
import json

LESSON_ID = '26-26-1-quantum-sensors'
circuit = QuantumCircuit(1)
circuit.rz(4.95673508, 0)
sv = Statevector.from_instruction(circuit)
print(json.dumps({'lesson': LESSON_ID, 'gate': 'rz', 'angle': 4.95673508, 'statevector': [complex(x).__repr__() for x in sv.data]}))
